label: Nicodemus
brief: Pharisee and ruler of the Jews who came to Jesus by night
note: speaks in John; not named in Acts

label: Nathanael
brief: Disciple from Cana whom Philip brought to Jesus
note: speaks in John; not named in Acts

label: Martha
brief: Sister of Mary and Lazarus of Bethany
note: speaks in John; not named in Acts

label: Mary of Bethany
note: speaks in John; not named in Acts

label: Mary Magdalene
brief: Woman from Magdala, first to see the risen Jesus
note: speaks in John; not named in Acts

label: Colossae
brief: City in Phrygia; Paul wrote to the church there
note: named in Col 1:2; not in Acts

label: Titus
note: named in Paul's letters; not in Acts

label: Philemon
brief: Christian at Colossae to whom Paul wrote
note: named in Phlm 1:1; not in Acts

label: Archippus
brief: Christian greeted in Philemon and Colossians
